companies.name: L3ハリス・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: ミサイル追跡衛星網向けに衛星本体(バス)16機をL3Harrisに納入(買収したLanterisが受注)
relations.text_en: Delivering 16 satellite buses to L3Harris for a missile-tracking constellation (won by Lanteris before the acquisition)

source.label: Intuitive Machines 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: our subsidiary was selected to build 16 satellite buses for its customer, L3Harris Technologies (L3Harris)

relations.text: 買収したLanterisが、子会社Hughes向けに大型通信衛星JUPITER 3を製造
relations.text_en: Lanteris built the JUPITER 3 communications satellite for subsidiary Hughes Network Systems

source.label: Intuitive Machines 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Lanteris built JUPITER 3, a transformational Ultra High Density Satellite, for Hughes Network Systems to be designated EchoStar XXIV.
source.note: Lanteris買収(2026年1月)前の実績です。
source.note_en: Work completed before the January 2026 Lanteris acquisition.

relations.text: 2025年12月、月探査向けの通信・測位サービスで戦略協力協定を締結
relations.text_en: Signed a December 2025 strategic cooperation agreement on lunar communications and navigation

source.label: Intuitive Machines 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: in December 2025, the Company signed a strategic cooperation agreement to advance interoperable infrastructures and provide communications and navigation services in support of lunar exploration with international partners, Leonardo, and Telespazio.

companies.name: ロッキード・マーティン

relations.text: 有人月探査など大型案件を狙う既存大手の競合
relations.text_en: An incumbent rival pursuing larger lunar contracts such as crewed missions

source.label: Intuitive Machines 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Competition in our addressable market is mainly divided between incumbents, such as Lockheed Martin and Blue Origin who pursue larger, more complex contracts such as crewed lunar missions, and next generation players, including our competitors on the CLPS contract such as Astrobotic and Firefly Aerospace.

source.quote: Competition in our addressable market is mainly divided between incumbents, such as Lockheed Martin and Blue Origin who pursue larger, more complex contracts such as crewed lunar missions, and next generation players, including our competitors on the CLPS contract such as Astrobotic and Firefly Aerospace.

relations.text: 防衛向けの衛星製造で競合

source.quote: For national security and defense market opportunities relevant to Lanteris, competitors include BAE Systems, K2 Space, Lockheed Martin, Millenium Space Systems, Northrop Grumman, Rocket Lab, and York Space Systems.
